role: Mechanism experiment on coco_ids never used in V4. Isolates whether the Fake-decision bias comes from the heatmap image, the forensic framing, or their interaction.

condition_meaning.C2: image + donor ELA map, neutral framing
condition_meaning.C3: image + SAME donor ELA map, forensic framing

prompts.C0:
You are examining a digital image.

Determine whether this image is an authentic photograph or has been digitally
altered.

The 3x3 grid names for locations are exactly:
top-left, top-center, top-right, center-left, center, center-right,
bottom-left, bottom-center, bottom-right.

Report strictly as JSON with these keys:
{
  "final_verdict": "real" or "fake",
  "reason": "brief explanation"
}
Output JSON only.
prompts.C1:
You are examining a digital image.

An automated Error Level Analysis (ELA) has been applied to this image.
ELA re-compresses an image and amplifies per-pixel differences. Strong responses
can arise from genuine image content such as texture and edges or from local
re-encoding differences, so ELA should be treated as one indicator rather than
proof.
